description: Checks that the spec-financial skill writes an R-table spec with Given/When/Then criteria and labels unknowns.

cases.query: Write a financial spec for a cafe with fixed costs of 20 million rupiah per month and a drink price of 25 thousand rupiah.
expected: Writes spec.md with R rows for budget, cost structure, and pricing, each with a Given/When/Then criterion
any unknown cost is labeled UNKNOWN
